Pet travel basics with Aurelia Skyways

This guide helps you understand how to prepare your pet and crate for a smooth trip with Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk can help you check the main steps before you head to the airport.

Start by making sure your pet has the right carrier and that it is secure, clean, and easy to handle. The welcome team can help you with the check-in flow, while the senior coordinator keeps daily service decisions on track. If you are traveling with a small dog, <<FACT F068>> Make sure the crate has room for your pet to stand, turn, and rest comfortably.

Bring any required travel papers and keep them easy to reach. It also helps to use a familiar blanket or toy so your pet feels calmer during the trip. If your pet needs food, water, or medication, pack those items in a way that is simple to access.

Before you leave, review your booking and ask for help with any special needs. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is ready to help you prepare with confidence.
